items.title: Apple's $50 Intelligence Usage Packs extend access to some AI features
items.excerpt: Instead of a subscription tier, Apple now sells $50 packs of extra AI usage credits for Creator Studio apps, including Logic Pro's AI assistant once the monthly limit is hit.
items.rationale: New pricing release: Logic Pro's AI assistant is now metered, and $50 packs buy more use. That changes the cost of producing in Logic, and the brief assigns this story to music.

items.title: 듀스, 31년 만의 정규 4집 21일 발매…프로듀싱 이현도·AI로 되살린 김성재 '완전체'
items.excerpt: 1990s hip-hop duo DEUX releases its first studio album in 31 years on Nov 21, produced by Lee Hyun-do, with the late Kim Sung-jae's voice recreated using AI to reunite the full duo.
items.rationale: A major K-pop release brings back a late member's voice with AI. It is a concrete, high-profile case of how the industry handles posthumous AI voices.

items.title: Waves Releases ILLUGEN 2.5
items.excerpt: Waves' AI text-to-sample generator ILLUGEN 2.5 arrives as a plugin version with deep Cubase 16 integration, generating one-shots and loops inside the DAW.
items.rationale: New tool release: an AI text-to-sample generator now works as a plugin inside the DAW, so producers can use it in their sessions right away.

items.title: SPDMX: Large-Scale Open Stem Audio From Symbolic Music
items.excerpt: Researchers release a large open multitrack stem-audio dataset rendered from symbolic music, sidestepping copyright limits on redistributing training audio for music AI tasks.
items.rationale: A new open dataset of training audio that is cleared of copyright problems. It speaks to the training-data fight running through the lawsuits.

items.title: TubeTube, 가사·이야기 입력하면 15분 만에 AI 영상 완성…작곡부터 편집까지 자동화
items.excerpt: Korean AI video service TubeTube launches an integrated tool that turns lyrics or a story into a finished video in about 15 minutes, automating composition, vocals, storyboard, images and editing.
items.rationale: New product launch: one Korean tool now goes from lyrics to a finished song and music video, composing and singing as well as editing. That lowers the cost of a release-ready track for small acts.
